name: Oahe Downstream Recreation Area (Campground 3)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-22: Esri World_Imagery at 450 m half-width (1.0 m/px) over the campground, 120 m half-width (0.27 m/px, also enlarged 2x) over the 201E-205E row and 110 m half-width (0.24 m/px) over 194E-198E and cabins C1-C3, every Go Outdoors SD facID=41 loop 70 unit point plotted; all frames rendered. Plus the engine's official per-site photos of 194E, 195E, 197E and 201E-205E, read 2026-11-22. The water is the Missouri River's channel below Oahe Dam's stilling basin, ~200 m wide (river, not creek); the campground is downstream of the dam (pads ~434-441 m DEM against ~488 m on Lake Oahe), so it is judged on the river. Pads to the riprap-edged bank across open mown lawn with only scattered cottonwoods, no road, cabin or day use between: 196E ~13 m, 194E ~14 m, 195E ~15 m, 197E ~21 m, 205E ~20 m, 204E ~32 m; the photos show the river right past each pad's lawn. 198E-203E are ~30-70 m back behind tree clumps (filtered views); the loop's inner sites have no view; cabins C1-C8 (not RV sites) line the bank further SE. A few clearly waterfront sites -> riverfront, with the sites named in the note.
inclusion_evidence: Go Outdoors SD engine https://reservations.gooutdoorssouthdakota.com/FacilityDetails.aspx?facID=41 ('Oahe Downstream Recreation Area'), sitesHashMap read 2026-11-22, loop 70 (Campground 3): 41 web-bookable electric RV sites 163E-205E (no 192E or 193E), 40 'Back-In Campsite' plus pull-thru 164E, 'Amp Service: 20/30/50', MaxEquipLength 49-138 ft, UnitBasePrice $30; camping cabins C1-C8 ($60); group shelter PSH3; hosts V4-V6 not sold online. GFP map 'Oahe Downstream Campground 3' https://gfp.sd.gov/userdocs/ods_cg3.pdf (ArcGIS Pro, 2024-05-15) shows the same sites, three restroom/shower buildings, two vault toilets, water, a playground and horseshoe pit; the overview map https://gfp.sd.gov/userdocs/ods_overview.pdf shows its own road along the channel's south bank from SD-1806 at the south end of the river bridge, where the park's dump station is. GFP park page https://gfp.sd.gov/parks/detail/oahe-downstream-recreation-area/: 'Day-use area and campground 3 remain open year-round.' Esri imagery 2026-11-22: gravel back-ins at the unit points on a loop south of the channel. Real drive-in RV campground; a 23-ft rig fits every RV site (shortest 49 ft). 1.03 km RV-site centroid to centroid from Campgrounds 1-2 (nearest sites 205E and 86E, 505 m apart across the channel; about 3 km by road). Not in the DB before (split from 5719 Oahe Downstream Recreation Area, 2026-11-22). Public (state): no price gate.
note: Campground 3 of Oahe Downstream Recreation Area, on the south bank of the Missouri River channel below Oahe Dam's stilling basin, 5 mi N of Fort Pierre, reached by its own road from SD-1806 at the south end of the river bridge (the park's dump station is at that turn). Campgrounds 1 and 2, across the channel, are a separate entry. Sites 194E-197E, 204E and 205E sit on open lawn at the river's edge; camping cabins C1-C8 line the bank to the south-east. --Claude

sites.note: Plus camping cabins C1-C8 along the river.

season.note: Open to camping all winter, when Campgrounds 1 and 2 are closed; between Oct. 1 and April 30 the water systems may be off.

fees.note: GFP publishes this park's own rate: electric $30 a night (the statewide $7 electrical fee is already in the electric figure). Residents and non-residents pay the same to camp; the entrance licence and the $10 non-resident reservation fee are what differ.

season.source: https://gfp.sd.gov/parks/detail/oahe-downstream-recreation-area/ read 2026-11-22: 'Open: Year-round. Campgrounds 1 and 2 closed to camping Nov. 15 through the last Friday of March for bald eagle winter roosting. Day-use area and campground 3 remain open year-round. Between Oct. 1 and April 30, water systems may be closed.'

Same fee shape as 5719.
